primary.$description: Primary brand role: the protagonist color that dominates the identity (BR-01).

secondary.$description: Secondary brand role: the luminous, premium accent (BR-02).

primaryHover.$description: Primary brand fill while hovered. TBD-08: tints and shades are not defined (C-06, OD-04), so this reads the pink shade token, which repeats the single brand value (BR-01); no tint or shade is generated.

primaryActive.$description: Primary brand fill while pressed. TBD-08: tints and shades are not defined (C-06, OD-04), so this reads the pink shade token, which repeats the single brand value (BR-01); no tint or shade is generated.

secondaryHover.$description: Secondary brand fill while hovered. TBD-08: tints and shades are not defined (C-06, OD-04), so this reads the yellow shade token, which repeats the single brand value (BR-02); no tint or shade is generated.

secondaryActive.$description: Secondary brand fill while pressed. TBD-08: tints and shades are not defined (C-06, OD-04), so this reads the yellow shade token, which repeats the single brand value (BR-02); no tint or shade is generated.

base.$description: Page background. It stays pure black, never dark gray (BR-03, REQ-012).

default.$description: Body text color: soft white on the black page (ADR-0032, TBD-04).

muted.$description: Secondary text color: help text, hints, and descriptions (ADR-0032, TBD-05).

inverted.$description: Text on a primary or secondary fill. Labels on primary-filled buttons must be black (SPEC.md §2.1 derived facts, BR-03).

disabled.$description: Text and borders of disabled controls (ADR-0032, TBD-05). Disabled controls are exempt from contrast minimums.

divider.$description: Thin divider lines (ADR-0032, TBD-05). A divider is decorative and exempt from contrast minimums.

card.$description: Card surface. TBD-06: no surface color is defined (C-05, OD-05); until then cards render on color.bg.base. This references a placeholder, not a brand value.

elevated.$description: Elevated surface (overlays). TBD-06: no surface color is defined (C-05, OD-05); this references a placeholder, not a brand value.

success.$description: Success feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). Never the only signal: the icon and the title say the type too (WCAG 1.4.1).

warning.$description: Warning feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). Never the only signal: the icon and the title say the type too (WCAG 1.4.1).

error.$description: Error feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). Never the only signal: the icon and the title say the type too (WCAG 1.4.1).

info.$description: Info feedback color (ADR-0032, TBD-07). Never the only signal: the icon and the title say the type too (WCAG 1.4.1).
